title: What's New: Enhancements to Chat with Copilot (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Demo - Enabling Bing Search and Getting Extension Answers
Demo - Using Copilot for Task Guidance in Extensions

features.name: Copilot Chat with Third-Party Documentation
features.description: Copilot can now answer user questions using documentation from installed third-party add-ons and partner extensions, broadening its knowledge beyond Microsoft Learn documentation.
caveats: Requires one-step setup enabling Bing search on copilot and agent capabilities page
PTE extensions require documentation provided within help URL

features.name: Bing Search Integration for Copilot
features.description: Administrators can enable Bing search on the copilot and agent capabilities page, allowing Copilot to automatically search relevant partner extension documentation to support users.
caveats: Works out of the box with only one step setup
Works automatically for apps source extensions that have provided link to their documentation

features.name: Extension-Specific Help Content
features.description: Partners can provide targeted help content in their documentation to address commonly asked questions, allowing users to be unblocked by Copilot without contacting support.
caveats: Content must be formatted to be readable for users on partner website
Copilot picks up content from structured documentation

features.name: Copilot Safety and Data Handling
features.description: Inputs and outputs go through various checks for safety from security standpoint and to reduce AI harms. Bing service is in the US with data not stored longer than a day. Copilot can connect to web but web cannot connect to Copilot.
caveats: Data goes to Bing service in the US
Data not stored longer than a day

features.name: Copilot with Bing Search - No Additional Cost
features.description: Using Bing Search within Copilot Chat does not cost more and incurs no one-time or service costs when using Bing Search within Copilot Chat in Business Central.
